title: Symbol Properties: expose Scale9Grid (9-slice scaling) in Properties panel
description: Scale9Grid is supported in the core model (types.ts) and SWF encoder (DefineScalingGrid tag 78) but there is no UI to set it. In Flash 8, this was accessible via Modify > Symbol Properties when a MovieClip was selected in the library, or via the Properties panel for a symbol. Add a '9-Slice Scaling' section to the symbol properties dialog or library panel. The UI should show a checkbox 'Enable guides for 9-slice scaling' and four number inputs (x, y, width, height) for the grid bounds.
